suite.name: UDP routing baseline
suite.author: SESHAT
suite.description: Plaintext UDP datagram loopback throughput baseline across the datagram size grid.

scenarios.name: baseline_udp_loopback_64B
scenarios.description: Plaintext UDP datagram throughput baseline (direct loopback, no gateway) — the ceiling DTLS / UDP-over-TLS are measured against. The SCG gateway is TCP-routing-only, so a *gateway* UDP-routing baseline is not possible.
